authorization_basis: Explicit user instruction: 好的，请继续进行phase6
scope: Retrospective one-time RADCURE locked test, HANCOCK OOD test, GSE65858 external test, and GSE41613 sensitivity analysis
outcome_use_policy: Held-out outcomes may be loaded only after token/hash/cohort-digest authorization; never for preprocessing, feature selection, tuning, threshold selection, model selection, or retuning
bootstrap_pairing: same resampled patient indices for all compared models within a cohort

RADCURE.feature_policy: numeric PyRadiomics vectors; exclude identifiers, metadata, diagnostics, and FMCIB; exact feature/order alignment required
RADCURE.missing_modality_policy: retain all frozen patients; fully missing radiomics rows trigger B7 clinical fallback

HANCOCK.feature_policy: same frozen baseline blood plus TMA cell-density loader as development

GSE65858.representation: within-sample ranks over outcome-independent common gene-symbol intersection

GSE41613.endpoint: all-cause overall survival; any source Dead category is an event

comparisons: B7 vs B6 on the identical non-abstained subset
B7 vs B2 on the identical non-abstained subset
RADCURE original radiomics vs shuffled/randomized controls

seed_aggregation.base_model_predictions: arithmetic mean across the five frozen seeds
seed_aggregation.b7_action_consensus: majority vote with ABSTAIN precedence, then FALLBACK, then AUGMENT
seed_aggregation.b7_risk: mean seed-specific B7 risk; consensus FALLBACK replaced by mean B2 risk; consensus ABSTAIN set to missing
